x1.description: First 1-dimensional input tensor of length M.

x2.description: Second 1-dimensional input tensor of length N.

mode.description: Either `valid`, `same` or `full`. By default the mode is set to `valid`, which returns an output of length max(M, N) - min(M, N) + 1. `same` returns an output of length max(M, N). `full` mode returns the convolution at each point of overlap, with an output length of N+M-1
constraints: mode must be one of valid, same, full
x and y must have broadcast-compatible shapes
